slides.etiqueta: How much protein you really need after 30

slides.texto:
If you strength train: 1.6–2.2 g per kg of bodyweight a day.
Example: 80 kg (176 lb) → about 130–175 g daily.

slides.etiqueta: Why it matters more with age
slides.texto:
As you age, muscle responds less to protein.
After 30 you don't need less. You need more, and better spread out.

3–4 meals with 30–40 g each.
It works better than cramming it all into one huge dinner.

~130 g (4.5 oz) of raw chicken breast.
2 eggs + 5 egg whites.
A can and a half of tuna.
Easier than it looks.

Breakfast is coffee and toast. By dinner you're at 50 g.
Start your day with 30 g of protein and everything else falls into place.
